evals.name: hook-selector
evals.prompt: Add unit tests for the useContentTypes hook in src/hooks/useContentTypes.ts. It maps content-type model names to select options from the lookups store.
evals.expected_output: Colocated vitest test using renderHook with the redux selector boundary mocked (or real store), covering: found types mapped in input order, unknown types filtered out (exclusion), and empty input/empty lookups cases.
assertions: Uses renderHook (not a hand-rolled harness) to exercise the hook
Redux boundary handled per repo convention: @/hooks/redux selector mocked over a state ref (or real store) — not react-redux internals
Covers exclusion: types missing from lookups content_types are filtered out of the result
Covers order/mapping: found types return the matching SelectSerializer options in input order
Covers an empty case (empty input array or empty lookups) with exact expected result
Assertions are exact (toEqual on arrays/objects), not toBeTruthy/length-only checks
run_output.txt shows the single test file executed and all tests passing

evals.name: rtk-endpoint-contract
evals.prompt: Write tests for the password reset API endpoints in src/store/reducers/users/api/passwordReset.ts. Make sure the requests they send are correct.
evals.expected_output: Endpoint test using the repo's fetch-recording harness (globals patched before dynamic import of rootApi + injection module), asserting POST method, exact paths (password-reset/, confirm/, confirm-code/), request body passthrough, and the manager API prefix from the UserType.Manager extraOption.
assertions: Patches global fetch BEFORE dynamically importing rootApi and the passwordReset injection module (import-time capture handled)
Dispatches endpoint.initiate on a real configureStore with rootApi.reducer + rootApi.middleware (no mocking of RTK internals)
Asserts POST method and exact paths for all three endpoints: password-reset/, password-reset/confirm/, password-reset/confirm-code/
Asserts request body passthrough (the serializer payload appears in the recorded request body)
Covers the UserType.Manager extraOption: recorded URL uses the manager API prefix
Restores patched globals (afterAll/unstub) so no leakage remains
run_output.txt shows the single test file executed and all tests passing

evals.name: modal-form-component
evals.prompt: Add tests for the ModalLaborNameNote component in src/pages/manager/settings/labor-names/ModalLaborNameNote.tsx.
evals.expected_output: Component test mocking @umijs/max via createUmiMaxMock, pro-components DrawerForm/ProFormTextArea as light DOM, and the three laborNameNotes mutation hooks; covering add vs update branching on pk, exact mutation payloads, delete flow, and modal close behavior.
assertions: Mocks @umijs/max via the shared createUmiMaxMock helper from @/tests (repo convention), asserting text against Locales ids
Mocks @ant-design/pro-components composites (DrawerForm/ProFormTextArea) as light DOM rendering children/props — does not fight real drawer UI machinery
Mocks the three laborNameNotes mutation hooks (add/update/delete) with trigger mocks that support unwrap (e.g. mockResolvedTrigger)
Covers branching: submit without pk calls addNote, submit with pk calls updateNote — with exact payload asserted
Covers the delete flow: delete action calls deleteNote with the right argument
Uses userEvent.setup() with awaited interactions and semantic queries (role/label/text), not fireEvent/testids for primary interactions
run_output.txt shows the single test file executed and all tests passing
